notes.title: Horde mode now in game and bug fixes
notes.notes:
We have updated the gameplay to be in a horde based 'wave' system so you now have set targets to reach per wave rather than just a continuous horde from the beginning. 

We have also fixed the bug that prevented scores being uploaded to the leaderboards.
